limits: Trace times are callback-boundary observations of held state, not sample-exact acoustic onset measurements.
Rates are free-running Hz and are not host-tempo synchronized.
Mode/order/octave and finite/headroom observations protect preserved behavior; they are not new improvements or a quality score.
Final output tails can include intentional delay and existing noise after all generated voices have retired.
Only this three-key gesture and the indicated twelve-second hold are tested.
